nameOrigin.text: The Town's history page says Alma was named after the grocery store owner's daughter.

timeline.text: Smelter employees petitioned the Park County Commissioners for incorporation on December 2, and the Town held its first meeting on December 4.
A fire destroyed many of the businesses in Alma, including the post office.
The original Alma School burned on May 15; construction of the new school began that summer.
A fire in March virtually wiped out the business district.
The Town bought the former Alma School for $1.00; it now holds the Town offices, library and community center.
